```{r}
library(tidyverse)
subway_df = 
  read_csv(file  = "NYC_Transit_Subway_Entrance_And_Exit_Data.csv") |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  select(line:route11, entry, vending, entrance_type, ada) |>
  mutate(
    entry = case_match(
      entry, 
      "YES" ~ TRUE,
      "NO" ~ FALSE
      )
  )
```
